title: Edgeless Window Content Scroll Clearance
description: All content inside all windows must be edgeless. Remove padding inset; use scroll clearance so the first line is hidden under chrome by default but scrolls into view when scrolling up. Applies to writer, tables, and all window bodies.
summary: Scroll only when content overflows viewport (rest layout height vs view height). Dead-island peek toggles at scroll top: wheel up enters edgeless, wheel down restores gap. Removed React forcing edgeless on every wheel. DOM scroll hosts skip dead-line offset when content fits and restore edgeless flag when scrollTop returns to dead line.
